DELETE /api/sub-stats: Delete every subscription-fetch record (the statistics log). Settings are kept.
GET /api/sub-stats/log: List individual subscription fetches, newest first. Filter by `user`, `ip`, `app`, `fmt` (format) and `status`; page with `before` (the id of the last row you got) and `limit`. Non-sudo admins only see fetches of their own users.
GET /api/sub-stats/settings: Read subscription-statistics settings: `enabled`, `retention_days`, `ip_per_min`, `user_per_hour` and `sub_rate_limit` (minimum seconds between two fetches of the same user). `0` means no limit.
PUT /api/sub-stats/settings: Change subscription-statistics settings and limits. Fetches over a limit get HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
GET /api/sub-stats/summary: Totals for the last `hours` hours: fetch count, unique users and IPs, bytes sent, average/max size, average duration, limited/blocked/error counts; plus breakdowns by app and format, top users, top IPs and a time series (hourly when `hours` is 72 or less, otherwise daily).
GET /api/blocked-ips: List blocked addresses, the failed-login attempts of the last 24 hours grouped by IP, the auto-block switch, its threshold and your own IP.
POST /api/blocked-ips: Block an IP address or CIDR range (`ip`, optional `reason`). You cannot block your own address or loopback. Blocked addresses get HTTP 403 on login and password change.
PUT /api/blocked-ips/auto: Turn automatic blocking on or off. When on, an IP that reaches the per-IP failed-login limit is blocked automatically.
GET /api/node-install/{job_id}: Progress and log of a node installation started over SSH. Pass `offset` to get only the new log lines.
PUT /api/node/{node_id}/extra: Save the node's extra settings (SSH access, VPS details, flags). Secrets are stored encrypted and are never returned.
GET /api/nodes/extras: Extra settings of all nodes (secrets are masked).
POST /api/ssh-keys: Save an SSH key in the key library (name, private key, optional passphrase). The private key is stored encrypted and never returned.
GET /api/cores/{core_id}/config: Get the Xray configuration of an extra core.
GET /api/chain: List relay/exit chains between servers and the state of each link.
PUT /api/chain/{relay}: Set which exit server a relay node forwards to (per inbound).
POST /api/outbounds/test: Run a connectivity test for an outbound on the panel or on a node (over SSH) and return the result.
PUT /api/admin/{name}/sub-profile: Set an admin's own subscription profile: domain, texts and external configs.
PUT /api/external-configs: Set extra config links appended to every link-based subscription, and the order of links.
PUT /api/external-configs/mine: Set the signed-in admin's own external configs.
PUT /api/ip-limit-settings: Turn the global IP limit on or off. Off = observe only (connected IPs are shown, nothing is blocked).
PUT /api/json-sub-settings: Change JSON subscription settings: clients, direct sites, external configs and the auto (balancer) config.
PUT /api/sub-domain: Change the address, path and last part used in subscription links.
PUT /api/sub-settings: Change subscription settings (update interval, support/announce texts, rate limit and similar).
PUT /api/sub-webpage: Change what users see when they open their subscription link in a browser.
PUT /api/user-cleanup: Change the auto-delete rules for expired users.
GET /api/auto-change: Read the automatic-change rules (rotate a node's IP list when traffic or time conditions are met).
GET /api/overview: Numbers for the dashboard overview page: users, traffic, nodes and admins.
GET /api/activity: Audit log of actions done in the panel (who did what, from which IP). Filter by actor and action; page with `before`.
GET /api/backup/list: List backups saved on the server (name, size, time).
GET /api/telegram: Read the Telegram bot configuration and its connection state.
GET /api/alerts: List the signed-in admin's alerts (new users, expiring users, node problems and similar).
GET /api/anti-theft: Read the anti-theft (subscription sharing) detector settings.
GET /api/messages/{thread}: Read the messages of a thread between an admin and the sudo admins. `after` returns only newer messages.
POST /api/messages/{thread}: Send a message in a thread.
GET /api/notify/counts: Unread alert and message counters for the menu badges.
PUT /api/user/{username}/warning: Set or clear a warning text shown to a user in their subscription page.
GET /api/external-panels: List connected external panels (3x-ui, s-ui and similar). Passwords are never returned.
POST /api/external-panels: Connect an external panel. Its login is stored encrypted.
PUT /api/external-panels/{panel_id}: Change an external panel's connection details.
GET /api/external-panels/{panel_id}/inbo: List the inbounds of an external panel.
POST /api/external-panels/{panel_id}/tes: Test the connection to an external panel.
GET /api/vpn: List the built-in VPN servers and their state.
PUT /api/vpn/servers/{key}: Change one built-in VPN server's settings.
PUT /api/decorations: Turn the festive decorations (for example the New Year theme) on or off for the panel and the subscription pages.
POST /api/xray/reset: Go back to the Xray core version that ships with the panel.
GET /api/license: Read the panel's license state: status, days left, limits and usage.
POST /api/admin: Create a new admin (sudo or reseller). Set `username`, `password` and the limits: `users_limit`, `traffic_limit`, `expire_date`, `max_user_ip_limit`, `max_user_hwid_limit`, `host_groups`, `can_copy_configs` and `can_edit_limits`.
PUT /api/brand: Change the panel's brand: the name shown in the sidebar, footer and subscription page, the company name and the support contact.
